description: Manages the creation, modification, deletion of RDS option groups.

parameters.name: access_key
parameters.description: AWS access key ID. See the AWS documentation for more information about access tokens https://docs.aws.amazon.com/general/latest/gr/aws-sec-cred-types.html#access-keys-and-secret-access-keys. The AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID or AWS_ACCESS_KEY environment variables may also be used in decreasing order of preference. The aws_access_key and profile options are mutually exclusive. The aws_access_key_id alias was added in release 5.1.0 for consistency with the AWS botocore SDK.

parameters.name: apply_immediately
parameters.description: Indicates whether the changes should be applied immediately, or during the next maintenance window. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: aws_ca_bundle
parameters.description: The location of a CA Bundle to use when validating SSL certificates. The AWS_CA_BUNDLE environment variable may also be used.

parameters.name: aws_config
parameters.description: A dictionary to modify the botocore configuration. Parameters can be found in the AWS documentation https://botocore.amazonaws.com/v1/documentation/api/latest/reference/config.html#botocore.config.Config.

parameters.name: debug_botocore_endpoint_logs
parameters.description: Use a botocore.endpoint logger to parse the unique (rather than total) "resource:action" API calls made during a task, outputing the set to the resource_actions key in the task results. Use the aws_resource_action callback to output to total list made during a playbook. The ANSIBLE_DEBUG_BOTOCORE_LOGS environment variable may also be used. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: endpoint_url
parameters.description: URL to connect to instead of the default AWS endpoints. While this can be used to connection to other AWS-compatible services the amazon.aws and community.aws collections are only tested against AWS. The AWS_URL environment variable may also be used.

parameters.name: engine_name
parameters.description: Specifies the name of the engine that this option group should be associated with.

parameters.name: major_engine_version
parameters.description: Specifies the major version of the engine that this option group should be associated with.

parameters.name: option_group_description
parameters.description: The description of the option group.

parameters.name: option_group_name
parameters.description: Specifies the name of the option group to be created.

parameters.name: options
parameters.description: Options in this list are added to the option group. If already present, the specified configuration is used to update the existing configuration. If none are supplied, any existing options are removed.

parameters.name: profile
parameters.description: A named AWS profile to use for authentication. See the AWS documentation for more information about named profiles https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cli/latest/userguide/cli-configure-profiles.html. The AWS_PROFILE environment variable may also be used. The profile option is mutually exclusive with the aws_access_key, aws_secret_key and session_token options.

parameters.name: purge_tags
parameters.description: If purge_tags=true and tags is set, existing tags will be purged from the resource to match exactly what is defined by tags parameter. If the tags parameter is not set then tags will not be modified, even if purge_tags=True. Tag keys beginning with aws: are reserved by Amazon and can not be modified. As such they will be ignored for the purposes of the purge_tags parameter. See the Amazon documentation for more information https://docs.aws.amazon.com/general/latest/gr/aws_tagging.html#tag-conventions. Choices: false true ← (default)

parameters.name: region
parameters.description: The AWS region to use. For global services such as IAM, Route53 and CloudFront, region is ignored. The AWS_REGION environment variable may also be used. See the Amazon AWS documentation for more information http://docs.aws.amazon.com/general/latest/gr/rande.html#ec2_region.

parameters.name: secret_key
parameters.description: AWS secret access key. See the AWS documentation for more information about access tokens https://docs.aws.amazon.com/general/latest/gr/aws-sec-cred-types.html#access-keys-and-secret-access-keys. The AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY or AWS_SECRET_KEY environment variables may also be used in decreasing order of preference. The secret_key and profile options are mutually exclusive. The aws_secret_access_key alias was added in release 5.1.0 for consistency with the AWS botocore SDK.

parameters.name: session_token
parameters.description: AWS STS session token for use with temporary credentials. See the AWS documentation for more information about access tokens https://docs.aws.amazon.com/general/latest/gr/aws-sec-cred-types.html#access-keys-and-secret-access-keys. The AWS_SESSION_TOKEN environment variable may also be used. The session_token and profile options are mutually exclusive.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Specifies whether the option group should be present or absent. Choices: "present" "absent"

parameters.name: tags
parameters.description: A dictionary representing the tags to be applied to the resource. If the tags parameter is not set then tags will not be modified.

parameters.name: validate_certs
parameters.description: When set to false, SSL certificates will not be validated for communication with the AWS APIs. Setting validate_certs=false is strongly discouraged, as an alternative, consider setting aws_ca_bundle instead. Choices: false true ← (default)

parameters.name: wait
parameters.description: Whether to wait for the cluster to be available or deleted. Choices: false true ← (default)

examples:
# Create an RDS Mysql Option group
- name: Create an RDS Mysql option group
  amazon.aws.rds_option_group:
    state: present
    option_group_name: test-mysql-option-group
    engine_name: mysql
    major_engine_version: 5.6
    option_group_description: test mysql option group
    apply_immediately: true
    options:
      - option_name: MEMCACHED
        port: 11211
        vpc_security_group_memberships:
          - "sg-d188c123"
        option_settings:
          - name: MAX_SIMULTANEOUS_CONNECTIONS
            value: "20"
          - name: CHUNK_SIZE_GROWTH_FACTOR
            value: "1.25"
  register: new_rds_mysql_option_group

# Remove currently configured options for an option group by removing options argument
- name: Create an RDS Mysql option group
  amazon.aws.rds_option_group:
    state: present
    option_group_name: test-mysql-option-group
    engine_name: mysql
    major_engine_version: 5.6
    option_group_description: test mysql option group
    apply_immediately: true
  register: rds_mysql_option_group

- name: Create an RDS Mysql option group using tags
  amazon.aws.rds_option_group:
    state: present
    option_group_name: test-mysql-option-group
    engine_name: mysql
    major_engine_version: 5.6
    option_group_description: test mysql option group
    apply_immediately: true
    tags:
      Tag1: tag1
      Tag2: tag2
  register: rds_mysql_option_group

# Delete an RDS Mysql Option group
- name: Delete an RDS Mysql option group
  amazon.aws.rds_option_group:
    state: absent
    option_group_name: test-mysql-option-group
  register: deleted_rds_mysql_option_group

return_values.name: allows_vpc_and_non_vpc_instance_memberships
return_values.description: Indicates whether this option group can be applied to both VPC and non-VPC instances. Returned: always Sample: false

return_values.name: changed
return_values.description: If the Option Group has changed. Returned: always Sample: true

return_values.name: engine_name
return_values.description: Indicates the name of the engine that this option group can be applied to. Returned: always Sample: "mysql"

return_values.name: major_engine_version
return_values.description: Indicates the major engine version associated with this option group. Returned: always Sample: "5.6"

return_values.name: option_group_arn
return_values.description: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) for the option group. Returned: always Sample: "arn:aws:rds:ap-southeast-2:123456789012:og:ansible-test-option-group"

return_values.name: option_group_description
return_values.description: Provides a description of the option group. Returned: always Sample: "test mysql option group"

return_values.name: option_group_name
return_values.description: Specifies the name of the option group. Returned: always Sample: "test-mysql-option-group"

return_values.name: options
return_values.description: Indicates what options are available in the option group. Returned: always

return_values.name: db_security_group_memberships
return_values.description: If the option requires access to a port, then this DB security group allows access to the port. Returned: always

return_values.name: db_security_group_name
return_values.description: The name of the DB security group. Returned: always Sample: "mydbsecuritygroup"

return_values.name: status
return_values.description: The status of the DB security group. Returned: always Sample: "available"

return_values.name: option_description
return_values.description: The description of the option. Returned: always Sample: "Innodb Memcached for MySQL"

return_values.name: option_name
return_values.description: The name of the option. Returned: always Sample: "MEMCACHED"

return_values.name: option_settings
return_values.description: The name of the option. Returned: always

return_values.name: allowed_values
return_values.description: The allowed values of the option setting. Returned: always Sample: "1-2048"

return_values.name: apply_type
return_values.description: The DB engine specific parameter type. Returned: always Sample: "STATIC"

return_values.name: data_type
return_values.description: The data type of the option setting. Returned: always Sample: "INTEGER"

return_values.name: default_value
return_values.description: The default value of the option setting. Returned: always Sample: "1024"

return_values.name: description
return_values.description: The description of the option setting. Returned: always Sample: "Verbose level for memcached."

return_values.name: is_collection
return_values.description: Indicates if the option setting is part of a collection. Returned: always Sample: true

return_values.name: is_modifiable
return_values.description: A Boolean value that, when true, indicates the option setting can be modified from the default. Returned: always Sample: true

return_values.name: name
return_values.description: The name of the option that has settings that you can set. Returned: always Sample: "INNODB_API_ENABLE_MDL"

return_values.name: value
return_values.description: The current value of the option setting. Returned: always Sample: "0"

return_values.name: permanent
return_values.description: Indicate if this option is permanent. Returned: always Sample: true

return_values.name: persistent
return_values.description: Indicate if this option is persistent. Returned: always Sample: true

return_values.name: port
return_values.description: If required, the port configured for this option to use. Returned: always Sample: 11211

return_values.name: vpc_security_group_memberships
return_values.description: If the option requires access to a port, then this VPC security group allows access to the port. Returned: always

return_values.name: vpc_security_group_id
return_values.description: The name of the VPC security group. Returned: always Sample: "sg-0cd636a23ae76e9a4"

return_values.name: tags
return_values.description: The tags associated the RDS option group. Returned: always Sample: {"Ansible": "Test"}

return_values.name: vpc_id
return_values.description: If present, this option group can only be applied to instances that are in the VPC indicated by this field. Returned: always Sample: "vpc-bf07e9d6"
